name: obsidian-finance
description: Optional folder-grounded equity and quarterly market research with on-demand SEC evidence acquisition, source cutoffs and protected checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: SEC evidence, equities and quarterly market research
interface.longDescription: Use equity-research for U.S.-listed companies and tw-equity-research for Taiwan Stock Exchange-listed companies. Each skill supports quarterly Obsidian research that preserves user edits and cites dated sources. Taiwan research includes monthly revenue, financial statements, material disclosures, and investor conference evidence. Use industry-research for quarterly market studies. Live SEC acquisition uses a genuine contact saved locally after first-use setup. Evidence gaps are reported explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Continue research in my designated managed equities folder at my specified assessment cutoff; discover required work, preserve prior reports and edits, and report evidence gaps and conditional horizon judgments.
